summary: This recipe analyzes neural population dynamics by mapping CePNEM-derived feeding tuning indices onto continuous UMAP manifold embeddings to reveal graded encoding patterns.
use_when: How is feeding encoding organized in the UMAP space?
Visualize neural feeding tuning on UMAP manifolds
Identify graded transitions in feeding-activated and feeding-inhibited neurons
Perform dimensionality reduction on neural data to study feeding behavior
Calculate and project feeding tuning coefficients into a continuous latent space
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
